title: Mutable canvas: ZoneLayer set, per-layer layout + hit-test
guards: runMultiZoneRenderSelfCheck extended (assertions 1-12); --multi-zone-render-check + --single-zone-compat-check + --zindex-relaunch-hit-test-check + --tile-world-bounds-check. Drives real setZones/upsertZoneLayer/removeZoneLayer + real FocusBroker register/unregister.
storageShape: B (additive over single-zone). Spec default. CONFIRM before T06 ripples 71 canvasState.tiles read-sites.
risks: R1 forward (T06/T09): _layoutLayerTile -> repositionFocusBorderIfNeeded reads the flat tileViews dict, not layer.tileViews. Harmless now (borderedTileId is always an active-zone tile) but the focus border won't track a layer-resident tile if T06/T09 ever focus one.

R2 visual: empty-state overlay stays installed on a layer-only canvas (setZones never calls updateEmptyStateVisibility; canvasState.tiles stays empty). No assertion affected; likely a visual artifact (morning gate).
R3 cosmetic: manifest adapterRegisteredOnAdd is hardcoded {tA:true,tG:true} literals, not re-queried (load-bearing assertions use live broker.requestFocus). Low.
R4 forward (T06): upsertZoneLayer replace-path keeps the zoneId's old z-position; a brand-new layer appends to top. Reasonable, undocumented z-order policy T06 depends on.
morningVisualGate: Live add/remove flicker when zones install/uninstall.
Z-paint correctness when a layer is upserted on top.
Cursor rects (resetCursorRects) for multiple zone-chrome headers.
No lost first-responder when a focused tile's layer is removed.
